column3: The best thing about Jinwoo's system isn't the quest. It's the numbers. Strength goes up. Stats go up. He can see himself getting stronger.
Researchers Teresa Amabile and Steven Kramer collected nearly twelve thousand daily diary entries from two hundred and thirty eight professionals.
When they looked at people's best days at work, the most common event was simple. They'd made progress on something meaningful. Even a small step.
That finding comes from their book and articles, and it's about work, not habits. But the idea travels well.
You don't have a status window. So make one. A calendar with an X for every day you showed up. A note on your phone. Anything that lets you see the streak grow.
